# EduLearn - Product Summary for LLMs

## Product Overview

EduLearn is an AI-powered study companion focused on real-world skill acquisition.
It helps users move beyond passive content consumption through personalized agents, accountability systems, and proof-of-work progress tracking.

Website: https://edulearn.fun

## Core Experience

### Personalized AI Learning
- AI tutor powered by Google Generative AI
- Personalized learning roadmaps based on user goals
- Chat-based guidance with follow-up explanations

### Active Skill Building
- Auto-generated quizzes and flashcards
- Practice loops designed for active recall
- Milestones and progress checkpoints

### Accountability and Consistency
- Streaks and gamified progression
- Leaderboards and community motivation
- Revision reminders and progress nudges

### Verifiable Proof-of-Work
- Certificates and achievement tracking
- Publicly shareable progress artifacts
- Optional blockchain-backed verification features on web

## Pricing

- Free: core AI learning features with daily limits
- Premium: advanced AI model access, higher limits, and additional features

## Platform Availability

- Web (edulearn.fun): full feature set including verification and wallet-connected rewards
- Mobile (iOS/Android): core learning, quizzes, roadmaps, and communities

## Technical Stack

- API: NestJS, PostgreSQL (Drizzle ORM)
- Web: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS
- Mobile: Expo React Native
- Auth: Supabase and OAuth providers
- AI: Google Generative AI (Gemini)

## Target Audience

- Learners building practical career skills
- Students and early-career professionals
- Communities and organizations training users at scale

## Example Skill Areas

- Software engineering
- Product design
- AI literacy and applied workflows
- Cybersecurity fundamentals
- Content creation and marketing
- Product management

## Keywords

AI study companion, skill acquisition, personalized learning roadmap, accountability learning app, active recall, quiz-based learning, verifiable achievements, proof-of-work learning, gamified education, outcome-driven learning
